value.title: F199 observed state repair closes B286-001

sections.name: body
sections.value: Round 2 of #286 at c58deb2a58e5d86ab0b7493c6e2ac5833bca21fd closes B286-001. activityObserved records the latest logical transition synchronously before queueing or early returns, boot resets it from the active context, and context-only reports use it; activityPublished retains its distinct acknowledgement/shutdown role. The four committed delayed-transport regressions are GREEN on this head and RED on d55bb57 (both arm directions, actual re-attachment and new-lifecycle boot). Dependency-free execution copied their exact bodies and fixture with assertion/wait/spy shims; authoritative CI runs the actual Vitest suite, now 125 runtime tests. The harness gift is encoded in those regressions, not just this note. Docs now describe every re-attach trigger and the map retaining every distinct reporting seat ID until daemon restart. No new loop, timer, poll or launch.
